Module org.example.sodoku
Package com.example.sudoku.model

Class SudokuModel

java.lang.Object
com.example.sudoku.model.SudokuModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
ISudokuModel
public class SudokuModel extends Object implements ISudokuModel
Model class for a 6x6 Sudoku game. Handles matrix generation, validation, hollowing logic, and hint system.

    • validation

      public boolean validation(int x, int y, int n)
      Validates whether a number can be placed at position (x, y). Checks row, column, and 2x3 block constraints. Blocks are 2 rows x 3 columns.
      Specified by:
      validation in interface ISudokuModel
      Parameters:
      x - row index
      y - column index
      n - number to validate (1-6)
      Returns:
      true if the number is valid at that position, false otherwise

    • generator

      public boolean generator(int i, int j)
      Recursively generates a valid completed Sudoku matrix using backtracking. Traverses column by column, row by row.
      Specified by:
      generator in interface ISudokuModel
      Parameters:
      i - row index
      j - column index
      Returns:
      true if the matrix was successfully completed, false otherwise

    • getBlockIndex

      private int getBlockIndex(int i, int j)
      Returns the block index (0-5) for a given position. Blocks are 2 rows x 3 columns, ordered left to right, top to bottom.
      Parameters:
      i - row index
      j - column index
      Returns:
      block index between 0 and 5

    • hollower

      public void hollower()
      Hollows out the completed matrix to create a playable puzzle. Saves the solution before hollowing. Guarantees a minimum of 2 hints per block and unique solutions. Removed positions are stored for the hint system.
      Specified by:
      hollower in interface ISudokuModel
